 ToffeeWeb Talk: No Grealish, No Problem! | Back-To-Back Newcastle Wins | ToffeeWeb Talk, Episode 12 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Patric Ridge is joined by Alfie Biggs and Jon Shea to dissect Everton ’s massive back-to-back victories over Newcastle United across the League Cup and Premier League. 
 The lads break down David Moyes’s tactical masterclass, praise Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall’s monstrous midfield numbers, and address the elephant in the room: the developing situation with Jack Grealish .
 OneFootball Videos
 Has he played his last game for the Toffees, and did Moyes even want him back this summer?
 Plus, a look ahead to Friday night’s clash against Frank Lampard’s Coventry City.
 Episode 12 is up on YouTube and Spotify . Make sure to let us know your thoughts in the comments.
